record.gloss_en: especially noticeable, important, or prominent
record.collocation: salient features · a salient point · the most salient issue
record.example_en: The report highlights three salient differences between the two plans.
record.example_zh: 报告突出说明了这两项方案之间的三个显著差异。
record.grammar_note: 形容词，多用于正式书面语，常修饰point、feature、issue。
record.contrast_note: salient指值得注意且重要；visible只表示可见。
record.editorial_reason: A comparison report demonstrates importance beyond mere visibility.

record.gloss_en: a person or organization required to pay taxes
record.collocation: local taxpayers · a taxpayer's money · individual taxpayers
record.example_en: Local taxpayers helped fund the library renovation.
record.example_zh: 当地纳税人共同承担了图书馆翻修的费用。
record.grammar_note: 可数名词；可指个人，也可指纳税机构。
record.contrast_note: taxpayer指负有纳税义务者；tax collector负责征税。
record.editorial_reason: Public spending example clearly links tax obligations and government revenue.

record.gloss_en: the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye that receives visual images
record.collocation: the human retina · retinal cells · damage to the retina
record.example_en: Light-sensitive cells in the retina help turn light into signals sent to the brain.
record.example_zh: 视网膜中的感光细胞帮助将光转换成传向大脑的信号。
record.grammar_note: 解剖名词，可数；复数retinas或retinae。
record.contrast_note: retina在眼球后部感光；cornea是眼球前部透明的角膜。
record.editorial_reason: Functional anatomy differentiates retina from cornea.

record.gloss_en: a group of things growing or gathered close together
record.collocation: a clump of trees · a clump of grass · clumps of soil
record.example_en: A clump of trees stood beside the empty field.
record.example_zh: 空旷田地旁长着一丛树。
record.grammar_note: 可数名词；a clump of后既可接复数可数名词（trees），也可接不可数物质名词（grass、soil）。
record.contrast_note: clump强调聚成一团或一簇；row强调排成一列。
record.editorial_reason: A spatial grouping naturally demonstrates the collective noun.

record.gloss_en: a message formerly sent using a telegraph system
record.collocation: send a telegram · receive a telegram · an urgent telegram
record.example_en: Her grandfather kept the telegram telling him that he had been offered his first job.
record.example_zh: 她的祖父一直保存着那封通知他获得第一份工作的电报。
record.grammar_note: 可数名词；历史通讯方式，不能当作现代即时消息的通常名称。
record.contrast_note: telegram是通过电报系统发送的消息；text message通过移动网络等发送。
record.editorial_reason: Family keepsake anchors its historically characteristic medium.

record.gloss_en: a statement about what is likely to happen in the future
record.collocation: make a prediction · an accurate prediction · weather predictions
record.example_en: The forecast included a prediction of heavy rain on Friday.
record.example_zh: 天气预报说星期五可能会下大雨。
record.grammar_note: 可数名词，常用prediction that...或prediction of...。
record.contrast_note: prediction是未来判断，不等于已经证实的事实。
record.editorial_reason: 天气预报使可检验但尚未发生的预测具有清晰时态。

record.gloss_en: having or bringing bad luck
record.collocation: an unlucky day · feel unlucky · an unlucky break
record.example_en: He was unlucky to miss the last train by just one minute.
record.example_zh: 他只差一分钟就错过末班车，真不走运。
record.grammar_note: 常见be unlucky to do something；也可形容带来厄运的事。
record.contrast_note: unlucky谈运气不佳；unhappy谈心情不快乐。
record.editorial_reason: 末班车的偶然失误比人物性格判断更贴合词义。

record.gloss_en: to make something impure or unsafe by adding a harmful or unwanted substance
record.collocation: contaminate drinking water · contaminated soil · food contamination
record.example_en: A damaged sewer pipe could contaminate nearby drinking water.
record.example_zh: 破损的污水管可能污染附近的饮用水。
record.grammar_note: 及物动词，contaminate A with B；contaminated常作形容词。
record.contrast_note: contaminate指混入不需要的物质；dirty可仅指表面脏污。
record.editorial_reason: Conditional water pollution is concrete while avoiding any invented confirmed incident.

record.gloss_en: a brother or sister of the same person
record.collocation: an older sibling · a younger sibling · sibling rivalry
record.example_en: She has two siblings, an older brother and a younger sister.
record.example_zh: 她有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。
record.grammar_note: 可数名词，复数siblings；不限定兄弟姐妹的性别。
record.contrast_note: sibling不包括cousin（堂表兄弟姐妹）。
record.editorial_reason: Gender-neutral sibling is especially useful when family relations matter but gender does not.

record.gloss_en: a person who independently examines financial accounts or procedures
record.collocation: an independent auditor · an internal auditor · appoint an auditor
record.example_en: An independent auditor examined the company's financial statements.
record.example_zh: 一名独立审计师审查了公司的财务报表。
record.grammar_note: 可数名词；audit是对应动词和名词，auditor指执行审核的人。
record.contrast_note: auditor负责审计；accountant负责会计工作，两者职责可能交叉但并不相同。
record.editorial_reason: The financial reporting example targets the prototypical audit role without claiming regulatory authority.

record.gloss_en: the period when a child is a baby
record.collocation: during infancy · early infancy · in its infancy
record.example_en: Healthy sleep patterns change rapidly during infancy.
record.example_zh: 婴儿期的睡眠规律变化很快。
record.grammar_note: infancy通常为不可数名词；也可比喻某事的初创阶段。
record.contrast_note: infancy专指婴儿阶段；childhood范围更广，包含更大的儿童。
record.editorial_reason: The developmental life stage is central; no medical recommendations are made.

record.gloss_zh: 有条件的；取决于条件的
record.gloss_en: depending on a particular condition being met
record.collocation: conditional approval · conditional offer · be conditional on approval
record.example_en: The offer is conditional on passing the final inspection.
record.example_zh: 这项要约以通过最终检查为条件。
record.grammar_note: 常用be conditional on/upon something。
record.contrast_note: conditional表示取决于先决条件；unconditional表示不附条件。
record.editorial_reason: Inspection as an explicit condition clarifies relation.

record.gloss_en: a large area of sea partly enclosed by land
record.collocation: a wide gulf · cross the gulf · the Gulf of Mexico
record.example_en: The fishing boats crossed the gulf before sunset.
record.example_zh: 渔船在日落前穿过了海湾。
record.grammar_note: gulf为可数名词，复数gulfs。
record.contrast_note: gulf是部分受陆地围绕的较大海域；bay也表示海湾，边界并非只靠面积判断。
record.editorial_reason: Maritime crossing fixes geographic sense, not a metaphorical divide.

record.gloss_en: principles concerning what is right or wrong in human conduct
record.collocation: professional ethics · research ethics · code of ethics
record.example_en: The committee reviewed whether the study met research ethics standards.
record.example_zh: 委员会审查了这项研究是否符合科研伦理规范。
record.grammar_note: ethics在伦理原则义中通常用复数形式，语法上常与学科名称的单数用法并存。
record.contrast_note: ethics强调判断行为对错的原则；law强调法律规定，两者可能有重叠但不等同。
record.editorial_reason: Research governance provides a concrete normative-principle context.

record.gloss_en: to tell someone a secret or personal matter because you trust them
record.collocation: confide in a friend · confide a secret to someone · confide that something happened
record.example_en: She confided in her friend about her worries.
record.example_zh: 她向朋友倾诉了自己的担忧。
record.grammar_note: confide in someone表示向某人倾诉；confide something to someone也可使用。
record.contrast_note: confide包含信任并透露私事；mention仅表示提及，不强调信任。
record.editorial_reason: A trusted private conversation fits source interpersonal disclosure.

record.gloss_en: directly related to the matter being considered
record.collocation: pertinent question · pertinent information · pertinent to the discussion
record.example_en: Her question was directly pertinent to the topic.
record.example_zh: 她的问题与这一主题直接相关。
record.grammar_note: pertinent常与to搭配，即be pertinent to something。
record.contrast_note: pertinent是切题的；interesting虽引人兴趣却未必相关。
record.editorial_reason: Direct topical relevance is explicit.

record.gloss_en: a dishonest person, especially one who steals or cheats
record.collocation: petty crook · a notorious crook · catch a crook
record.example_en: The detective suspected that the visitor was a crook.
record.example_zh: 侦探怀疑那名访客是个不法之徒。
record.grammar_note: crook表示不诚实的人时可数，复数crooks，通常非正式。
record.contrast_note: crook指骗子或罪犯；thief特别指偷窃者，范围较窄。
record.editorial_reason: Suspected dishonest person context avoids declaring unproven guilt.

record.gloss_en: having no fixed limit or restriction
record.collocation: unlimited access · unlimited data · unlimited time
record.example_en: The subscription offers unlimited access to the lesson library.
record.example_zh: 该订阅服务允许用户不限次数地访问课程资料库。
record.grammar_note: unlimited是形容词，放在名词之前。
record.contrast_note: unlimited表示没有固定上限；free强调不收费，两者并非同义。
record.editorial_reason: Access without numerical cap does not imply no subscription price.

record.gloss_en: a person or company that provides insurance coverage in exchange for premiums
record.collocation: health insurer · major insurer · contact the insurer
record.example_en: The insurer reviewed the claim before making a decision.
record.example_zh: 保险公司在作出决定前审查了理赔申请。
record.grammar_note: insurer为可数名词，复数insurers。
record.contrast_note: insurer提供保险保障；insured是被保险人。
record.editorial_reason: Reviewing a claim distinguishes provider from policyholder.

record.gloss_en: a person who rides a bicycle
record.collocation: road cyclist · experienced cyclist · group of cyclists
record.example_en: The cyclist stopped at the red light.
record.example_zh: 骑行者在红灯前停了下来。
record.grammar_note: cyclist为可数名词，复数cyclists。
record.contrast_note: cyclist指骑自行车的人；motorcyclist指骑摩托车的人。
record.editorial_reason: Traffic action exemplifies rider type without assuming racing.

record.gloss_en: a person who rides a horse in races
record.collocation: professional jockey · champion jockey · a jockey rides in a race
record.example_en: The jockey guided the horse around the track.
record.example_zh: 骑师驾驭赛马绕着跑道前进。
record.grammar_note: jockey为可数名词，复数jockeys。
record.contrast_note: jockey是赛马骑师；cyclist是自行车骑手。
record.editorial_reason: Track racing context fixes occupation.

record.gloss_en: serving as a sign that suggests something is true or likely
record.collocation: be indicative of a trend · indicative results · indicative price
record.example_en: These results are indicative of a larger trend.
record.example_zh: 这些结果显示可能存在一个更大的趋势。
record.grammar_note: indicative常用于be indicative of something。
record.contrast_note: indicative暗示某种趋势或状况；conclusive表示证据足以得出确定结论。
record.editorial_reason: Suggestive trend evidence without claiming proof.

record.gloss_en: to cut or chemically produce a design on a hard surface
record.collocation: etch a pattern · etch into glass · laser-etched design
record.example_en: The artist etched a pattern into the glass.
record.example_zh: 艺术家在玻璃上刻出了一幅图案。
record.grammar_note: etch为及物动词，常接图案，也可用etch into/on。
record.contrast_note: etch指通过刻划或腐蚀在表面形成图案；paint通常是涂上颜料。
record.editorial_reason: Glass design evokes etched surface.

record.gloss_en: to deliberately keep back something that someone expects or is entitled to receive
record.collocation: withhold information · withhold payment · withhold consent
record.example_en: The agency withheld the report until the investigation ended.
record.example_zh: 该机构在调查结束前暂不对外提供这份报告。
record.grammar_note: 及物动词；withhold something from someone；过去式withheld。
record.contrast_note: withhold强调有意不予提供，delay只表示推迟。
record.editorial_reason: 限定时间的报告扣留体现主动保留信息，不暗示非法。
